one_line: Astrophysicist and science planner whose ionization equation transformed stellar spectroscopy and Indian scientific institutions.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, lean, slightly stooped from long hours at a desk, with a calm, thoughtful presence.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium brown Bengali complexion, high forehead, thin straight eyebrows, sharp nose, small neatly trimmed moustache, faint under-eye lines; default expression is focused and serious, with bright analytical eyes behind spectacles.
appearance.hair: Short, slightly wavy black hair parted neatly to the left, combed flat, with a few subtle greying strands at the temples; wears thin round metal spectacles with dark earpieces, no headwear.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-20th-century Indian scholar attire: an off-white long-sleeved cotton kurta with a straight band collar and buttoned placket, falling to mid-thigh; a simple charcoal-grey woolen Nehru-style vest over it, reaching just below the waist and closely fitted; loose off-white cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles; a plain dark brown leather belt barely visible under the vest; dark brown lace-up leather shoes with a slightly worn look; he sometimes has a light khadi cotton shawl in soft beige draped over his left shoulder in more formal scenes, but the default look keeps the shawl folded over his left forearm; overall textiles are matte, practical and slightly rumpled, with no ornate patterns, only subtle vertical weave texture in the kurta and vest.
appearance.signature: A worn dark brown leather briefcase carried in his left hand, slightly bulging with rolled papers, and in his right hand a single rolled chart of a stellar spectrum and ionization curves, secured by a plain string, often used as a pointing prop.

ref_desc: Meghnad Saha is a mid-40s lean Bengali man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, round metal spectacles, off-white kurta, charcoal-grey vest, off-white churidar, dark brown shoes, carrying a dark brown briefcase and rolled stellar-spectrum chart in an off-white, charcoal-grey, dark brown, soft beige and deep blue palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Meghnad Saha: a mid-40s lean Bengali man with an oval medium-brown face, high forehead, small moustache, and thoughtful serious expression, wearing short wavy black hair parted to the left and thin round metal spectacles. He is dressed in an off-white long-sleeved cotton kurta with a band collar and straight hem to mid-thigh, layered under a close-fitting charcoal-grey Nehru-style vest, paired with loose off-white churidar trousers and dark brown lace-up leather shoes. A soft beige khadi shawl is neatly folded over his left forearm, not covering his torso, while his left hand grips a worn dark brown leather briefcase and his right hand holds a single rolled chart of a stellar spectrum and ionization curves tied with plain string, ready to gesture with it. Show him in a neutral standing pose, front and slight three-quarter views if possible, clearly presenting his face, hairstyle, vest and kurta layers, churidar, shoes, briefcase and rolled chart, using a restrained palette of off-white, charcoal grey, dark brown, soft beige and a deep blue accent for the chart’s visible edge.
